senses.gloss: (√אב, v. אבב; cmp. גבר, חבר) to be bent, pressed, thick.

units: Snh. 109ᵇ (play on Abiram, Num. XVI, 1) שאִי׳ לבו מ׳ וכ׳ Ms. M. (Rashi לבבו, ed. עצמו) he hardened his heart against repentance.

senses.gloss: (denom. of אֵבֶר) to measure wings, to define city limits, for Sabbath distances, in cases of wing-like projections beyond the line.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 5:1">Erub. V, 1</cite> <he>כיצד מְאַבְּרִין</he> (accord. to Rab’s spelling, while Sam. read <he>מְעַבְּרִין</he>, v. Y. ib. 22ᵇ, Bab. ib. 53ᵃ) how do we measure outskirts of a city in order to draw the Sabbath line?; v. etymol. definit. Y. a. Babl. ll. cc. a. Y. Ber. VII, 12ᶜ top.
Gen. R. s. 42 (play on Shemeber, Gen. XIV, 2) שמְאַבֵּר וכ׳ Ar. s. v. שמאבר (ed. שהיה פורח) he took wings to fly and obtain wealth.
